name: Emanation Vector

phase_0.boundary_condition: The ontological horizon of the Absolute

VINIT.justification: The pre-emanative state before the first point of light emerges from non-being.

TANCH.justification: The final containment field that prevents the emanation from dissipating into total entropy.

AFWD.justification: The directed movement of energy from the source toward the periphery.

AREV.justification: The movement of light back toward the source through contemplation or resistance.

CLINK.justification: The sequential linking of lower planes to higher planes through intermediary vectors.

IMSCRIB.justification: The recognition of the source within the individual ray of light.

FSPLIT.justification: The division of the singular white light into the duality of form and essence.

FFUSE.justification: The merging of form and essence back into the singular white light.

EVALT.justification: The state where the emanation maintains its purity and intensity.

EVALF.justification: The state where the emanation is dimmed by density or distance.

ENGAGR.justification: The simultaneous presence of light and shadow where neither dominates.

IFIX.justification: The permanent crystallization of the emanation into a fixed material form.

phase_3.void_description: The silence before the first vibration of the vector.
phase_3.true_description: The alignment of the vector with the source intent.
phase_3.false_description: The deviation or scattering of the vector into chaos.
phase_3.both_description: The state of potentiality where the vector is both source and manifestation.

steps.domain_action: The unmanifest source prepares to project the first vector.
The emanation begins its outward trajectory from the center.
The vector identifies its own nature as a direct extension of the source.
The vector encounters the first plane of existence and divides into form and essence.
The essence branch maintains high frequency and proceeds toward higher realization.
The essence continues its forward morphism toward the boundary.
The form branch undergoes attenuation and slows as it interacts with density.
The form branch reflects off the material plane and begins a return path.
The returning form and the advancing essence meet at the threshold of perception.
The form and essence reunite to recover the original integrity of the ray.
The unified ray links to the next lower level of the hierarchy.
The vector leaves a permanent trace of its passage in the cosmic record.
The vector reaches the final boundary and is sealed within the total system.

phase_5.compiler_frontend: The Logos which translates divine intent into geometric vectors.
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: Resonant harmonics between different levels of the emanation.
phase_5.memory_mechanism: The Akasha which stores the trajectory and intensity of every ray.
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: The Great Cycle which determines the timing of outflow and return.
phase_5.alfs_store: The Primordial Point from which all vectors originate.

phase_6.cycle_cost: The dilution of intensity as the vector expands in volume.
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: Concentrated potential at the source point.
phase_6.post_cycle_state: Distributed presence across the entire field of manifestation.
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The total energy of the emanation is conserved through the return path.
